code.label: geography.transportation.icao_code
code.why: OurAirports' ICAO airport codes, four capital letters. Nominated so the label does not move with the sample.

code_display.label: geography.transportation.icao_code
code_display.why: The same values as code, nominated with it.

level.label: representation.text.word
level.why: A closed set of one level name, airport; nominated so the label does not move with the inference's confidence on a single repeated value.

depth.label: representation.numeric.integer_number
depth.why: Always 0 in a one-level list; nominated so the column keeps the integer it is, as the other code lists' depth does.

description.label: representation.text.plain_text
description.why: OurAirports' name for an airport, such as 'London Heathrow Airport': free text, labelled as the other code lists label their descriptions. Inferred, finetype reads airport names as city names.

description_full.label: representation.text.plain_text
description_full.why: The same as description in a flat list, labelled with it.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: The UTC date of OurAirports' commit, such as 2026-11-16, used as the identifier of the snapshot, as the other code lists' release is. Stored as text, so every code list's release has one type; nominated so finetype does not type it a DATE.

text_source.label: representation.text.word
text_source.why: A closed set of one value, ourairports; nominated so the label does not move with the inference's confidence on a single repeated value.

corpus.label: representation.text.plain_text
corpus.why: The lowered, accent-stripped description_full the search reads, labelled with it. Inferred it is `unknown`.

ourairports_id.label: representation.identifier.increment
ourairports_id.why: OurAirports' integer record id, the primary key of its database, stored as BIGINT. Inferred, finetype reads it as a numeric code, which it types as text.

type.label: representation.text.word
type.why: A closed set of five type names, such as small_airport; nominated so the label does not move with the inference's confidence.

municipality.label: representation.text.plain_text
municipality.why: The place an airport serves, as OurAirports records it: free text that is often more than one place's name, such as 'Winnipeg/Saint Andrews', 'Bialla, Matalilu, Ewase' or 'Sydney (Mascot)'. Inferred, finetype reads it as a city name.

wikipedia_link.label: technology.internet.url
wikipedia_link.why: A link to the airport's Wikipedia article, an http or https URL. Inferred, finetype reads it as an S3 URI.
